actions.unpin_message.props.instructions:
Your own chat ID: message @getmyid_bot and send /my_id. A group's ID: add your bot, send /start there, test the New Update trigger before publishing and copy chat.id from that message, not the 123456789 sample. A public channel can use its @username.

The bot must be in the group or channel, or the person must have messaged it first, or Telegram answers "chat not found".

auth.description:
**Authentication**:

1. Begin a conversation with the [Botfather](https://telegram.me/BotFather).
2. Type in "/newbot"
3. Choose a name for your bot
4. Choose a username for your bot.
5. Copy the token BotFather sends and paste it here.
triggers.new_telegram_message.descriptio: Triggers when the bot receives a Telegram update (message, callback query, poll answer, etc.).
triggers.new_telegram_message.props.trig:
**One webhook per bot.** Publishing another flow with this bot token stops this one. Use one flow per bot and branch on the update type.

After publishing, Retest shows sample data. Test before publishing to load a real update.
triggers.new_telegram_message.props.upda: Empty receives every update except Chat Member and reactions.
